notes.title: Astrocraft First Playtest is Live
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! I'm incredibly excited to announce that [b]Astrocraft[/b] has reached its first major milestone! As a solo developer, this space station simulator represents months of passion and hard work, and it's finally ready for its very first playtest. I need YOUR feedback to make it stellar![/p][h3][b]What is Astrocraft?[/b][/h3][p]Astrocraft combines the best elements of Gas Station Simulator, Supermarket Simulator, and Satisfactory in a sci-fi setting. Start on an empty asteroid and build your dream space station - mine resources, craft valuable goods, serve diverse space travelers, and gradually automate your operations with hired workers. It's retail simulation meets factory automation in the depths of space![/p][h3][b]What's in This Early Build?[/b][/h3][p]This playtest includes the core foundation of Astrocraft:[/p][list][*][p][b]Basic mining and resource gathering[/b] with your trusty mining laser[/p][/*][*][p][b]Simple shop mechanics[/b] - build infrastructure and sell goods to visiting space travelers[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early production chains[/b] - refine raw materials into more valuable products[/p][/*][*][p][b]Basic building placement[/b] and station layout[/p][/*][*][p][b]Initial customer AI[/b] with different types of space travelers[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What's NOT included yet:[/b] Workers, advanced automation, combat/defense systems, farming, and many planned features from our roadmap.[/p][h3][b]I Need Your Feedback On:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Core gameplay loop[/b] - Is the mine → produce → sell cycle engaging?[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI/UX and controls[/b] - How intuitive does everything feel?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance and pacing[/b] - Does progression feel rewarding?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance and bugs[/b] - Help us squash any issues you encounter[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fun factor[/b] - Most importantly, are you having a good time?[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]How to Join the Playtest[/b][/h3][p]Click the "Request Access" button on our Steam page and we'll send you an invite as soon as possible. The current build offers about 15 - 30 minutes of content as you experiment with the basic systems.[/p][h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3][p]Based on your feedback, I'll be implementing features from my roadmap over the next 6 months, including worker automation, custom tile-based buildings, voxel-based digging, farming systems, and exciting events like pirate raids. Your input will directly influence which features I prioritize![/p][p]I'm aiming for full release in [b]6 to 9 months[/b], and this playtest is the first step in that journey. Every bug report, suggestion, and piece of feedback helps me build the space station sim of your dreams.[/p][p]Ready to become a space entrepreneur? [b]Request access now and let's build something amazing together![/b][/p]
